startupObservation: One cold CNI Add attempt timed out; the native runtime retry recovered and both Pods became ready. No performance conclusion is drawn from shared nested VM timing.
scope: Proves lazy IPv4 TCP/UDP idle expiry and tuple reinsertion, current backend selection, stale backend reply rejection, lock contention/recovery, map capacity/publication safety, and real guest/policy regression. Does not finish background reclamation of unrelated idle/orphan entries, TCP SYN/FIN/RST lifecycle, guest established-flow restart survival, SNAT/hairpin/collision resolution, IPv6 packet NAT or packet NodePort. Packet Services remain opt-in.
